label: Send request: $ZED_CUSTOM_url
args: 'r=$(command -v http-runner) || r="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Zed/extensions/work/http-runner/bin/http-runner"; [ -x "$r" ] || r="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/zed/extensions/work/http-runner/bin/http-runner"; [ -x "$r" ] || { echo "http-runner is not installed yet: open an .http file and wait for the HTTP Runner extension to download it." >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$r" "$@"'

label: HTTP: send all requests in file
